name: quizpulse
description: QuizPulse — a real-time, Mentimeter-style live quiz app (React + Socket.io).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix Frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.dev:frontend: node api.js && npm --prefix Frontend run dev
scripts.dev:backend: node api.js && npm --prefix backend run dev
